newsitem.title: ITALY: Confidence vote possible on jobs pact - Italy's Treu.
newsitem.headline: Confidence vote possible on jobs pact - Italy's Treu.

text.p: Italian Labour Minister Tiziano Treu said on Friday the government could call a confidence vote to speed up passage of a decree law aimed at boosting jobs.
"The decision is to proceed swiftly, if necessary with a confidence vote," Treu told private station Italia Radio in an interview.
He said the decree law would be sent to parliament next week and the centre-left government would decide whether to call a confidence test to sweep aside many blocking amendments still outstanding.
The decree law was approved by the Italian cabinet last month and is designed to complete provisions made in a September pact between government, unions and employers to boost jobs.
The package aims to simplify procedures to free up public expenditure on jobs.
